desktop_preview: Muuqaal hordhac ah: matoorka shaandhaynta weli lagama xirin kombiyuutarkan. Badhanku wuxuu kaliya muujinayaa sida barnaamijku u shaqayn doono.
state_on_detail_no_delay: Qalabka muusigga waa laga saaray dhammaan barnaamijyada.
engine_error_no_pactl: Qalabka codka lama helin (pactl). Waaiya waxay u baahan tahay PulseAudio, ama PipeWire oo leh pipewire-pulse.
engine_error_no_sound_server: Server-ka codku ma shaqaynayo (PulseAudio ama PipeWire).
engine_error_no_systemd: Nidaamkan ma laha fadhi isticmaale oo systemd ah, kaas oo shaandhada ka wada gadaal.
engine_error_no_output: Lama helin af-hayeen (speakers) ama sameecado dhegaha.
engine_error_service_failed:
Shaandhadu waxay ku joogsatay khalad. Faahfaahin:
{details}
autostart_body: Shaandhee codka isla marka aad soo gasho kombiyuutarka.
blur_body_desktop: Waxay daboolaysaa dadka iyo sawirrada shaashadda, daaqad kasta dusheeda, inta Waaiya furan tahay (way shaqaysaa haddii shaandhada codku daaran tahay iyo haddii kaleba). Kombiyuutarkan ayay ka shaqaysaa; meelna waxba looma diro. Xiridda daaqadda Waaiya waxay joojisaa qarinta.
blur_fail_body_desktop: Daaran: shaashadda oo dhan waa la daboolaa marka kombiyuutarku aad u gaabis yahay ama qarintu fashilanto; gujintu weli way gaartaa daaqadaha hoose. Damsan: shaashaddu way muuqanaysaa iyadoo xariiq casaan ahi ku jiro korka.
blur_status_on_visible_desktop: Qarintu way daaran tahay. Desktop-kani qarinta wuxuu ku muujiyaa sawir-qaadista shaashaddiisa, sidaas darteed meel la qariyay way qarsoonaanaysaa ilaa muuqaalku isbeddelo.
blur_status_no_capture:
Qarintu ma arki karto shaashadda. Faahfaahin:
{details}
blur_status_no_overlay_desktop:
Qarintu kama muuqan karto daaqadaha kale dushooda desktop-kan. Faahfaahin:
{details}
blur_status_share_dialog: Ka dooro shaashaddaada daaqadda wadaagista shaashadda oo ogolow. Waaiya hal mar oo kaliya ayay weydiisaa; sawirku kombiyuutarkan ayuu ku jiraa.
blur_status_exited:
Qarintu si lama filaan ah ayay u joogsatay. Dami oo dib u daar doorasho qarin si aad mar kale isku daydo. Faahfaahin:
{details}
engine_detector_failed: Aaladda garata heesaha haweenka lama soo shubin, sidaas darteed codadka waa la aamusiiyaa inta doorashadaas daaran tahay.
blur_status_uncovered: Shaashad (monitor) kama daboolna qarinta: lalama wadaagin, ama goor dambe ayaa la galiyay. Dami oo dib u daar doorasho qarin, oo ka dooro shaashad kasta daaqadda wadaagista shaashadda.
blur_status_models_missing_desktop: Moodeelada qarintu kuma jiraan rakibaaddan, sidaas darteed waxba ma dabooli karto; xariiq casaan ah ayaa ku hadhaya korka shaashadda. Dib u rakib Waaiya.
diag_note_desktop: Waxa Waaiya ku aragto kombiyuutarkan. Koobiyee oo sii qofka ku caawinaya. Barnaamijka laftiisu waxba ma diro.
setting_hold_silence_body_desktop: Waa lagu talinayaa. Haddii shaandhayntu iskeed u joogsato (khalad, adiga ma aha), barnaamijyada kale way aamusnaanayaan ilaa aad dib u bilowdo ama aad riixdo Jooji, halkii ay muusig aan la shaandheyn daari lahaayeen.
setting_stereo_body_desktop: Damsan: mono, oo kombiyuutarka ka qaata awood yar. Daaran: wuxuu kala ilaaliyaa dhinaca bidix iyo midig. Haddii kombiyuutarku aad ugu gaabis yahay stereo, iskiis ayuu ugu wareegaa mono.
link_entry_body_desktop: Dhaji link YouTube, TikTok ama Instagram si aad u daawato adigoo shaandhadu daaran tahay, ama si aad u kaydiso muusig la'aan.
link_entry_body_watch: Dhaji link YouTube, TikTok ama Instagram si aad ugu daawato browser-kaaga adigoo shaandhadu daaran tahay.
link_watch_note_desktop: Wuxuu ka furmaa browser-kaaga. Waaiya marka hore ayay bilaabaysaa shaandhada, sidaas darteed muusigga halkaasna waa laga saarayaa.
link_filter_failed: Shaandhadu ma bilaabmin, sidaas darteed link-ga lama furin. Ka bilow bogga Shaandho oo mar kale isku day.
link_singing_note: Heesaha haweenka sidoo kale waa la aamusiiyaa, sida dejintaada.
singing_keep_body: Qalabka muusigga waa la saarayaa laakiin codadka heesaha waa la hayaa, sidaas darteed muxaadaro uu hoos ku jiro nashiid waxay sidoo kale haysaa codka nashiidka; in taasi ay ansax tahay iyo in kale adiga ayay kuu taal.
singing_keep_no_model: Noocan ma laha moodeelka heesaha, sidaas darteed codku wuu aamusnaanayaa inta tani daaran tahay. Dami.
fix_filter_apps_title: Barnaamijyada la maqlo iyagoo aan la shaandheyn
fix_filter_apps_body: Barnaamijyadan waxay daaraan codkooda asalka ah: Waaiya ma shaandhayso mana aamusiiso.
fix_pick_playing_desktop: Barnaamijyada hadda cod daaraya, iyo kuwa horay loo doortay.
fix_blur_apps_body: Dabool ma jiro marka mid ka mid ah barnaamijyadan uu kaligiis shaashadda ku jiro. Daboolladu way soo laabtaan isla marka aad ka baxdo, ama mar kasta oo Waaiya aysan hubin barnaamijka la muujinayo.
fix_blur_apps_needs_setup: Waxay u baahan tahay habaynta hal mar ah: la'aanteed Waaiya ma garan karto barnaamijka shaashadda ku jira, sidaas darteed qarintu meel walba way ku sii jirtaa.
fix_blur_apps_helper_mode: Caawiyaha Waaiya ma shaqaynayo, sidaas darteed barnaamijka shaashadda ku jira lama akhrin karo. Qarintu meel walba way ku sii jirtaa ilaa caawiyaha dib looga bilaabo bogga Habaynta.
fix_hand_body: Inta qarintu shaqaynayso, ku jiid qayb kasta oo shaashadda ah si aad u daboosho. Way daboolnaanaysaa ilaa aad ka saarto ama qarintu joogsato.
fix_hand_not_running: Waxaa la heli karaa inta qarintu shaqaynayso: shaandhayntu daaran tahay, ikhtiyaar qarin ahna daaran yahay.
fix_note_body: Calaamadee marka uu dhaco. Qoraalku wuxuu hayaa waqtiga, barnaamijka iyo dejinta. Wuxuu ku jiraa qalabkan, waligiisna lama diro.
fix_wrong_sound: Cod si khalad ah ayaa looga saaray
fix_wrong_screen: Si khalad ah ayaa loo daboolay
fix_noted: Waa la qoray ({count} qoraal oo ku jira qalabkan).
fix_notes_delete_ask: Ma la tirtiraa dhammaan qoraallada? Tan dib looma celin karo.
worship_body: Ikhtiyaari. Waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa taleefankan iyadoo laga eegayo meesha aad doorato. Waxba lama diro.
worship_place_no_match: Magaalo lama helin. Waxaad gelin kartaa isku-duwayaasha (coordinates) beddelkeeda.
worship_place_invalid: Meeshan lama isticmaali karo. Mar kale dooro.
worship_method_note: Waxaa loo doortay dalka magaalada. Dooro midka masjidkaagu raaco.
worship_no_times: Halkan maanta ma jiraan waqtiyo salaadeed: qorraxdu ma soo baxdo ama ma dhacdo.
worship_silent_body: Laga bilaabo waqti kasta oo salaad, “Do Not Disturb” waa la daaraa daqiiqadaha hoose, kadibna taleefanku sidii aad u haysay ayuu ku noqdaa.
worship_mute_body: Waqti kasta oo salaad, codka warbaahinta (muuqaallada, muusigga, ciyaaraha) waa la aamusiiyaa daqiiqadaha hoose. Ogeysiisku isla markiiba wuu soo celin karaa codka.
worship_dnd_needed: U oggolow Waaiya inay beddesho “Do Not Disturb”, haddii kale taleefanku ma aamusi karo.
worship_exact_needed: Waaiya looma oggola alaarmiyada iyo xusuusinta, sidaas darteed isbeddel kastaa wuu dib u dhici karaa ilaa 10 daqiiqo, ama ka badan marka taleefanku hurdo.
worship_notifications_needed: Ogeysiisyadu waa damsan yihiin: ma arki doontid marka taleefanku aamuso ama uu soo noqdo.
worship_tones_title: Cod garaac iyo cod ogeysiis oo fudud
worship_tones_body: Waaiya ma shaandheyn karto codka garaaca ama ogeysiisyada, kaliya way beddeli kartaa. Dooro cod fudud oo aan muusig lahayn:
worship_tone_permission: U oggolow Waaiya inay wax ka beddesho dejinta nidaamka, soo noqo, oo mar kale taabo.
worship_tone_failed: Taleefankani uma oggolaan Waaiya inay beddesho. Dejinta Codka (Sound), dooro cod la yiraahdo “Waaiya plain”.
worship_sms_title: SMS ugu jawaab wicitaannada inta salaadda
worship_sms_body: Daqiiqadaha aamusnaanta ee ka dambeeya waqti kasta oo salaad, wicitaan la daayay isagoo garaacaya wuxuu helaa hal SMS. Hal mar lambar kasta salaad kasta; waligeed looma diro lambarro qarsoon ama lambarro gaagaaban.
worship_sms_cost: Jawaab kastaa waa SMS caadi ah oo ka baxda SIM-kaaga, qiimaha qorshahaaga. Waxba lama diro marka aad roaming ku jirto.
worship_sms_roaming: Hadda roaming ayaad ku jirtaa: SMS lama dirayo.
worship_sms_log_title: Jawaabaha la diray (taleefankan oo keliya ayay ku jiraan)
worship_why_dnd: Si taleefanku u aamuso waqtiyada salaadda, bogga xiga ku oggolow gelitaanka “Do Not Disturb” ee Waaiya.
worship_why_exact: Si ay waqtiga saxda ah wax u qabato, bogga xiga ku oggolow Waaiya inay dejiso alaarmiyo iyo xusuusin. La'aanteed, isbeddelladu waxay dib u dhici karaan ilaa 10 daqiiqo.
worship_why_notifications: Oggolow ogeysiisyada si aad u aragto isbeddel kasta oo aad uga noqon karto.
worship_why_write: Si aad u beddesho codka garaaca ama ogeysiiska, bogga xiga ku oggolow Waaiya inay wax ka beddesho dejinta nidaamka.
worship_why_phone: Si ay u ogaato in wicitaan garaacayo iyo lambarkiisa, Waaiya waxay u baahan tahay ogolaanshaha Taleefanka (Phone) iyo Diiwaanka wicitaannada (Call logs). Waxba kama baxaan taleefanka marka laga reebo jawaabtaada.
worship_why_sms: Si ay u dirto jawaabtaada, Waaiya waxay u baahan tahay ogolaansho ay SMS ku dirto. Waxay dirtaa oo keliya jawaabtaas, ugu badnaan hal mar lambar kasta salaad kasta.
worship_missing_dnd: Gelitaanka “Do Not Disturb” lama oggolaan, sidaas darteed aamusnaantu way damsan tahay.
worship_missing_phone: Ogolaanshaha Taleefanka iyo Diiwaanka wicitaannada lama bixin, sidaas darteed jawaabta SMS-ku way damsan tahay.
worship_missing_sms: Ogolaanshaha dirista SMS lama bixin, sidaas darteed jawaabta SMS-ku way damsan tahay.
protect_body: Waqtiga daciifnimada marka laga yaabo inaad rabto inaad damiso shaandhaynta. Hadda, adigoo deggan, dooro muddo sugid ah: markaas badhanka joojinta isla markiiba ma joojiyo shaandhaynta, waxaadna mar kale go'aansanaysaa marka muddadu dhammaato. Waalidku sidoo kale wuu dhigi karaa PIN.
protect_delay_body: Tusaale ahaan, 30 daqiiqo: waxaad riixdaa badhanka joojinta, laakiin shaandhayntu way sii shaqaynaysaa. 30 daqiiqo kadib, boggani wuxuu ku weydiinayaa inaad weli rabto inaad joojiso. Riix “Xaqiiji” 15 daqiiqo gudahood waana istaagaysaa; haddii kale waxba isma beddelaan. Sidaas oo kale ayay tahay demista dabool ama ilaalin kale. Daarista waxyaabaha had iyo jeer isla markiiba way shaqaysaa.
protect_pin_body: Marka PIN jiro, isbeddel kasta oo yareeya ilaalinta marka hore wuu weydiiyaa. Beddelka muddada sugitaanka ama PIN-ka sidoo kale wuu weydiiyaa.
protect_pin_forgot: Haddii PIN-ka la illaawo, dib u dejin ma jirto: kaliya tirtirista xogta Waaiya ama dib u rakibisteeda, taas oo sidoo kale tirtirta dhammaan dejinteeda.
protect_pin_differ: Labada PIN ee cusub isku mid ma aha.
protect_pin_wrong: PIN khaldan. {count} isku day ayaa kaa harsan ka hor hakad.
protect_locked: Isku dayo khaldan oo aad u badan. Mar kale isku day {time}.
protect_pending: {what}: waa la sugayaa ilaa {time}. Kadib ku xaqiiji “Dejinta”.
protect_ready: {what}: sugiddii way dhammaatay. Weli ma rabtaa? Riix “Xaqiiji” ka hor {time}; haddii kale waxba isma beddelaan.
protect_wait_body: {what} hadda ma dhacayo. Saacadda {time}, haddii aad weli rabto, ku xaqiiji “Dejinta” 15 daqiiqo gudahood. Haddii aadan waxba samayn, waxba isma beddelaan.
protect_started: Waa la sugayaa ilaa {time}. Kadib ku xaqiiji “Dejinta”.
protect_limits: Waxa aysan tani joojin karin: ku-qasab joojinta (force stop), ka saarista barnaamijka, tirtirista xogta Waaiya iyo dejinta Android lafteeda. Xannibaaddooda waxay u baahan tahay awoodaha maamulaha qalabka (device admin) ama helitaanka (accessibility), oo Waaiya aysan isticmaalin. Tani waxay kaa ilaalisaa waqti daciifnimo, ma aha qof go'aansaday.
protect_limits_desktop: Waxa aysan tani joojin karin: amarka waaiya ee terminal-ka, ka saarista Waaiya ama tirtirista galka dejinteeda. Tani waxay kaa ilaalisaa waqti daciifnimo, ma aha qof go'aansaday.
protect_limits_windows: Waxa aysan tani joojin karin: amarka waaiya-filter.exe ee terminal-ka, ka saarista Waaiya ama tirtirista galka dejinteeda. Tani waxay kaa ilaalisaa waqti daciifnimo, ma aha qof go'aansaday.
protect_what_strictness: Ka dhig qarinta mid ka adkaan yar
protect_what_delay: U beddel sugidda ka hor damin: {value}
